Connect providers and tools in Aura
Use the same conversations, projects, tasks and connections as your JACO workspace. This APK supplies local AI and phone integration; the full workspace runs in Termux or on a JACO hub.

1. Download the Android runtime package from the same JACO release as this app.
2. Install or open Termux and follow the package installation instructions. Android asks you to approve app installation separately.
3. Start JACO in Termux, return here and check the local runtime URL.
4. Open Aura to connect model providers and tools. Local discovery and environment import require your approval there.

For a remote hub, enter its HTTPS URL. Sign in through your browser; the local AI engine token is never sent to a remote hub.
Allow local AI on this phone?

JACO will run a foreground service with a notification and store imported models privately in this app. It does not download models or connect paid providers automatically. You can stop the service here at any time. Android may also ask for notification permission.
